title: refresh --json
description: mode is full or incremental when every board that ran used that mode, mixed otherwise, null when no board ran. rerank (optional) holds the per-board re-rank results when --rerank was given or the automatic step ran (a skipped step reports rerank_disabled). A board whose lease is held by another process reports already_running true. Exit 12 prints this object (partial_results) when a board is refresh_failed, truncated or disabled; the error envelope is for a total failure.
